items.headline: Long-dormant coins are waking up
items.detail: Liveliness 0.620 is 4.1σ up vs its month. Rising = old coins moving (distribution/rotation); falling = holders sitting still (accumulation).
items.framing: Older coins are starting to move — liveliness ticked up. Interesting "the patient money is stirring" angle; not a direction call.

items.headline: The valuation read is being pulled by sentiment
items.detail: The composite sits at the 15th percentile, but the sentiment axis is at 57 while the rest average 21 — the one dimension running hot.

items.headline: 8.16M SPX left in a day at a loss
items.detail: 2026-10-07: 42 wallets dropped below the 5k bar with 8.16M SPX, 6.0σ above the usual churn — loss-led (capitulation).
